note: 42 measured regions on 20 of the 35 pages account for 17 figures and 15 tables, with 10 regions excluded: three are not separate exhibits (the p11 and p19 panel pairs are each one two-panel figure measured twice because the panels overlap in x, and the p18 region is Table 10's page-break continuation), and seven are fragments of the appendix's single uncaptioned annual-flow table, which is printed as one block per gauging point across p31-p34 and is recorded once, on p31 r2. Pages 8, 9 and 14 carry no region and no exhibit: the dense vector paths the detector saw there are display equations (7)-(18) and (21)-(23), and equation numbers are not exhibit numbers. The paper runs Figures 1-13 and Tables 1-12 in the body; the appendix then reprints two tables and four plates from published sources whose captions carry foreign numbers ('Figure 15.6', 'Figure 3.6') and two of which carry no caption at all. Pages 31-35 are scanned plates, so neither foreign caption exists in the text layer and both were typed from 400 dpi crops. One region holds two printed exhibits on p31 r1, and one table is split over a page break on p17/p18; both are documented in the row notes rather than given extra rows. The body's printed folio runs one page behind the PDF (the p19 sheet prints 'Page 18 of 22') and the appendix sheets carry no folio at all, so page_order and doc_order come from the measured positions only. The two sensitivity plots (Figures 11 and 12) print their series keys as bare numbers at the right spine, so their legend field is 'none' and the values are described in the notes.
rules: In the body caption side is set by kind, not by section: every table caption sits above its art and every figure caption below it; the appendix plates break the pattern, printing Figure 3.6 above its map, and every body caption is a bare noun phrase with voice none, no condition and no conclusion [caption.position] [caption.voice]

Tables in the body are closed box grids with a rule between every row, while the two appendix tables and the p4 notation glossary are open-sided three-rule ledgers; no table in this paper uses a diagonal header [table.rule_style] [table.diagonal_header]

Only Table 5 puts units in the headers; Tables 6, 8, 9 and 10 float 'unit: m3/s' or 'Unit: km3' beside the caption outside the box, and the risk tables carry '%' inside the cells - so units_in_header must be read off the header row, not off the page [table.units_in_header] [caption.units]

Two two-panel figures are measured as four regions because their panels overlap in x; the pair owns one caption, so one region of each pair is a duplicate and the exhibit must be given one row, not two [geometry.panel_count] [place.doc_order]

A table can break across a page and resume without its header: the resumed rows on p18 carry no caption, no header and no unit, so they are a split fragment of the Table 10 row rather than a table of their own [table.continued] [place.page_order]

The appendix is scanned source material: its captions live in the raster and not in the text layer, its numbering restarts at foreign numbers ('Figure 15.6', 'Figure 3.6'), and two plates print no caption at all, which is recorded as caption_source none rather than as a hypothesis [caption.numbering] [caption.verbatim]

One uncaptioned appendix table is printed as one block per gauging point over four pages, titled only on its first block; region count therefore exceeds exhibit count and the surplus regions are excluded as fragments of the single recorded row [table.header_rows] [place.section_path]

Sixteen exhibits are never named in the prose (Tables 1, 2, 4, 6, 11 and 12, Figures 1, 3, 4 and 10, and all six appendix rows), so their mentions record count 0 with an empty style list rather than a guessed lead sentence [mention.count] [mention.first_page]

The prose says 'multi-dam system' while two legends print 'Mluti-Dam System'; legends are transcribed from the raster as printed, and the spelling split is a finding, not a typo to fix in the record [geometry.legend] [caption.verbatim]

Figures 11 and 12 print their series keys as bare numbers at the right spine with no colour swatches, so legend is none and the key values belong in the note, not in the legend field; their axes carry no unit at all [geometry.legend] [geometry.data_labels]

Scanned plates break the usual page arithmetic: the printed folio is one page behind the PDF and the plates reprint another publication's figure numbers, so section paths and ordering must come from measured geometry and the printed headings, never from the folio or the caption number [place.section_path] [place.page_order]

An unlabelled exhibit still gets a row: the p4 notation glossary and the two uncaptioned appendix plates are recorded with caption_source none and their evidence in the note, because leaving them out would hide real printed exhibits [caption.concludes] [caption.numbering]

No caption, no table number and no unit anywhere: the only text above it is the prose lead-in 'We will define the following variables here as they are widely used throughout our paper.'
